'has' followed by a past participle is the perfect tense, not possession, so a falsifiable outcome like 'succeeds after the shared tree has moved past X' rates falsifiability=fail and implementation-independence=fail ('behavior asserts source-code presence'). chokepoint checks the entitlement, reserves before dispatch and settles after, through the existing meter (p2p/metered-invocation.ts, DAO P-031). Today the meter is only an explicit door (cupboard:meter-invocation) plus the delegated-spawn honor path, so a paid tool is metered only if its serving code remembers to call it. Removed from the original text: x402 pay-per-call and monthly settlement from tool_invocations, because the rails are signed vouchers with batch settlement (DAO P-020/P-033).
